The Ukrainian People's Republic ( UPR ) [ d ] [ e ] was a short-lived state in Eastern Europe . Prior to its proclamation, the Central Council of Ukraine was elected in March 1917 as a result of the February Revolution , and in June declared Ukrainian autonomy within Russia, which was later recognized by the Russian Provisional Government . Following the October Revolution , the Central Council of Ukraine denounced the Bolshevik seizure of power and proclaimed the establishment of the Ukrainian People's Republic in the approximate territory Russian governorates of Kiev , Volhynia , Kharkov , Kherson , Yekaterinoslav , Poltava , Chernigov and Podolia . The republic formally declared its independence from Russia on 22 January 1918.
